dialogues.jp: 目を閉じていたとしても、桜の匂いが鼻につく。
dialogues.en:
I can still smell the cherry blossom even with my eyes
closed.
dialogues.text:
I can still smell the cherry blossom even with my eyes
closed.

dialogues.jp:
机に座りながら、ただ夜が｛ふ／更｝けるのを待ってい
た。
dialogues.en: I was waiting for the sunrise, sitting at my desk.
dialogues.text: I was waiting for the sunrise, sitting at my desk.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「お兄ちゃん……いる？」
ベッドの中からか細い声が響く。
dialogues.en: A small voice called me from the bed.
dialogues.text: A small voice called me from the bed.

dialogues.jp: もう何十回目かも分からない呼びかけ。
dialogues.en: She's been doing that dozens of times.
dialogues.text: She's been doing that dozens of times.

dialogues.jp: 「あぁ」
自分でも驚くほどやさしい声。
dialogues.en: I answered in a soft voice which even surprised me.
dialogues.text: I answered in a soft voice which even surprised me.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「あ……うん……ごめんね」

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「謝ることなんてなんにもないよ」

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「ベッドとっちゃってる……」

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「いいんだ……俺のことは気にしないで」
dialogues.en: "It's not a problem...... Don't worry about me."
dialogues.text: "It's not a problem...... Don't worry about me."

dialogues.jp: 気にしちゃいけないんだ。
なにも出来ない。

ここから離れれば、音夢は俺のことを捜して心
を｛つぶ／潰｝してしまうだろう。
dialogues.en:
If I leave here now, Nemu would break her heart looking for
me.
dialogues.text:
If I leave here now, Nemu would break her heart looking for
me.

dialogues.jp:
話し掛けたり抱きしめたりしてしまえば、歯止
めも効かず想いを伝えてしまう。
dialogues.en:
If I talked to her, or hold her in my arms, then I won't be
able to stop myself and tell her how I really feel.
dialogues.text:
If I talked to her, or hold her in my arms, then I won't be
able to stop myself and tell her how I really feel.

dialogues.jp:
無力を痛感しつつ――本当なら、それすらも許
されないのだ。
dialogues.en:
I felt powerless. But I'm not even allowed to feel that way
either.
dialogues.text:
I felt powerless. But I'm not even allowed to feel that way
either.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「お兄ちゃん」

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「お、お兄ちゃん！？」

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「いるよ」

ベッドから起き上がってきそうな勢いに、よう
やく口が開く。
dialogues.en:
Nemu was upset, she was about to sit up from the bed, then I
opened my mouth.
dialogues.text:
Nemu was upset, she was about to sit up from the bed, then I
opened my mouth.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「あ、うん……あの……見える場所にいて欲し
　い」
dialogues.en: "Oh, okay...... Uh...... can you sit where I can see you?"
dialogues.text: "Oh, okay...... Uh...... can you sit where I can see you?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「……分かった」
ベッド脇の階段に座る。
dialogues.en: I sat on the stairs by the bed.
dialogues.text: I sat on the stairs by the bed.

dialogues.jp: 「これでいいか？」

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「うん」
上半身を起こしていた音夢が微笑む。
dialogues.en: Nemu was sitting up, and she smiled.
dialogues.text: Nemu was sitting up, and she smiled.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「ありがとう」

月明かりに照らされて、桜の花に囲まれて、女
神のような美しさで笑う。
dialogues.en:
She was lit up by the moonlight, surrounded by the cherry
blossoms and smiling like a goddess.
dialogues.text:
She was lit up by the moonlight, surrounded by the cherry
blossoms and smiling like a goddess.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「また、桜の花びらが出てきた」

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「……なんでもないよ」

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「あはは……なんでもないわけないよ」
涙を精一杯｛こら／堪｝えるようにうつむく。
dialogues.en: She looked down as she was trying not to cry.
dialogues.text: She looked down as she was trying not to cry.

dialogues.jp:
「……なぁ音夢、その花びらが出たとき、なに
　か考えたか？」
dialogues.en:
"Hey, were you thinking about anything when the petals came
out?"
dialogues.text:
"Hey, were you thinking about anything when the petals came
out?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「いや、俺のことを考えてたのか？」

よく考えたら質問も恥ずかしかったが、気にし
ないことにする。
dialogues.en:
The question embarrassed me, but I decided not to care about
it.
dialogues.text:
The question embarrassed me, but I decided not to care about
it.

dialogues.jp: 「一体なにを？」

想い出をほとんど失いながら、なにを思い出し
たのか。
dialogues.en:
I wonder what she remembered after she lost most of her
memories.
dialogues.text:
I wonder what she remembered after she lost most of her
memories.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「お兄ちゃんと学園行きたいなって。えへへへ」
dialogues.en: "I was thinking about going back to school with you."
dialogues.text: "I was thinking about going back to school with you."

dialogues.jp: 過去でなく未来の話。
dialogues.en: It wasn't about the past, but the future.
dialogues.text: It wasn't about the past, but the future.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「あと、あのね……」
dialogues.en: "And...... You're the one who gave me this bell, right?"
dialogues.text: "And...... You're the one who gave me this bell, right?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「この鈴をくれたの、お兄ちゃんだよね」
リリン――と音夢が首の鈴をはじく。
dialogues.en: Nemu rang the bell on her neck.
dialogues.text: Nemu rang the bell on her neck.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「なんか、なんかね。一人で部屋にいたら大切
　な何かをなくしたような――迷子の気分になっ
　てきたの」
dialogues.en:
"Well. I felt like a lost child being in the room all by
myself. And then I felt like I lost something very
important......"
dialogues.text:
"Well. I felt like a lost child being in the room all by
myself. And then I felt like I lost something very
important......"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「そうしたらこの鈴のこと思い出して――」

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「この鈴、お兄ちゃんがくれたんだよね？　覚
　えてないんだけど」
dialogues.en: "Didn't you give me this bell? Although I don't remember..."
dialogues.text: "Didn't you give me this bell? Although I don't remember..."

dialogues.jp: 子供の頃、玩具を壊して作った音夢の鈴。
dialogues.en: I made her bell out of a toy when we were a child.
dialogues.text: I made her bell out of a toy when we were a child.

dialogues.jp: そんな小さな絆からなのか。
dialogues.en: It started from that small bond between us.
dialogues.text: It started from that small bond between us.

dialogues.jp: 終わりが始まってしまったのは。
「あぁ」
なんて愚か。

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「う〜ん、なにか……とても大切なことを忘れ
　ている気がするの。なんだろうね？」
dialogues.en:
"You know, I feel like I'm forgetting something really
important. I wonder what it could be."
dialogues.text:
"You know, I feel like I'm forgetting something really
important. I wonder what it could be."

dialogues.jp: ぼろぼろ、と服の袖から花びらがこぼれる。
dialogues.en: Then the petals came out of her sleeves.
dialogues.text: Then the petals came out of her sleeves.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「ねぇ、お兄ちゃん、お願いがあるんだけど？」
dialogues.en: "Oniichan, I have a favor to ask..."
dialogues.text: "Oniichan, I have a favor to ask..."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「なんだ」
額を押さえてうめく。
dialogues.en: I pressed my forehead and moaned.
dialogues.text: I pressed my forehead and moaned.

dialogues.jp:
「かったるいことじゃなければ……全力でやっ
　てやる」
dialogues.en:
"If it's not too much of a pain, then I'd do anything for
you with all of my heart."
dialogues.text:
"If it's not too much of a pain, then I'd do anything for
you with all of my heart."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「なにそれ……っ……んん」

咳を抑えこんだのか、喉に手を当てて音夢が笑
う。
dialogues.en:
Nemu laughed as she put her hand over her throat, as she
suppressed the cough.
dialogues.text:
Nemu laughed as she put her hand over her throat, as she
suppressed the cough.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「明日ね、ずっと一緒にいてくれないかな」
dialogues.en: "Would you stay with me all day tomorrow?"
dialogues.text: "Would you stay with me all day tomorrow?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「なにか、やっぱり、とても大切なモノをなく
　した気がするの」
dialogues.en: "I really feel like I lost something very important."
dialogues.text: "I really feel like I lost something very important."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「私と一緒に、なくしたもの探して欲しいの」
dialogues.en: "I want you to look for it with me."
dialogues.text: "I want you to look for it with me."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「なんだよそれ」

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「分からないけど……それはお兄ちゃんに関係
　してるものだと思うから」
dialogues.en:
"I'm not sure...... but I think it has something to do with
you."
dialogues.text:
"I'm not sure...... but I think it has something to do with
you."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「そうか」
なくした想い。
恋心。
なくした想いはどこにあるのか。
dialogues.en: Where could the lost soul be?
dialogues.text: Where could the lost soul be?

dialogues.jp: 形のないモノなのに。
どこに。
う。
（あれ、さくらが火にくべてなかったか？）
dialogues.en: (Didn't Sakura burn it in that fire?)
dialogues.text: (Didn't Sakura burn it in that fire?)

dialogues.jp: だらだらだらだら。

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「お兄ちゃん、なにか顔色が悪いよ」

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「……気のせいだ」
まずい。

幸せの青い鳥を、とっくに焼き鳥にして食べて
いた気分とか。
dialogues.en: I feel like I already barbecued the blue bird of happiness.
dialogues.text: I feel like I already barbecued the blue bird of happiness.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「お兄ちゃん、一緒に寝てくれないかな」

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「は？　隣ってことか？」

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「うん」

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「……今日だけだぞ」

自分の心とは正反対の言葉を吐き出し、布団の
中にもぐりこむ。
dialogues.en: I went into bed, saying totally opposite words.
dialogues.text: I went into bed, saying totally opposite words.

dialogues.jp: 桜の匂いに包まれるベッド。
dialogues.en: The bed was wrapped with the smell of cherry blossom.
dialogues.text: The bed was wrapped with the smell of cherry blossom.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「あ、そうだお兄ちゃん」

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「どうした？」
背中から笑い声が聞こえる。

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「えへへへ……実は来週から学園に行ってもい
　いって言われたんだよ」
dialogues.en: "The doctor told me that I can go back to school next week."
dialogues.text: "The doctor told me that I can go back to school next week."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「本当か！？」

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「うん」

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「……そうか」
嬉しい話題だ。

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「今日ね、本校の制服も買ってきたんだ。可愛
　いんだよ」
dialogues.en: "I got my new school uniform today. It's cute."
dialogues.text: "I got my new school uniform today. It's cute."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「そうか」

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「来週が楽しみだね」

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「楽しみにしてるよ」

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「でも、まずは明日が楽しみだよ」
dialogues.en: "Yeah, right. But I can't wait until tomorrow."
dialogues.text: "Yeah, right. But I can't wait until tomorrow."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「明日ね」

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「うん」
明日、か。
今日が終わっても明日が訪れる。

けれど、俺の明日と、音夢の明日は違うのかも
知れない。
dialogues.en: But, my tomorrow and her tomorrow may be different.
dialogues.text: But, my tomorrow and her tomorrow may be different.

dialogues.jp: 胸が痛んだ。
リリン――
音夢が身じろぎすると鈴が鳴った。
dialogues.en: The bell rang as Nemu moved a little.
dialogues.text: The bell rang as Nemu moved a little.

dialogues.jp: その鈴は迷子にならないための目印だった。
dialogues.en: That bell was meant to prevent her from getting lost.
dialogues.text: That bell was meant to prevent her from getting lost.

dialogues.jp: 俺が音夢を見つけるための。
dialogues.en: It was for me to find Nemu.
dialogues.text: It was for me to find Nemu.

dialogues.jp: 音夢が俺を呼ぶための。
dialogues.en: It was for her to call me.
dialogues.text: It was for her to call me.

dialogues.jp:
たったひとつの鈴が再びふたりを結んでしまっ
た。
dialogues.en: The tiny bell connected us once again.
dialogues.text: The tiny bell connected us once again.

dialogues.jp: ◆繋がってしまった想い◆

ひとりになるのが怖いという音夢を、俺のベッ
ドに寝かせる。
dialogues.en:
Nemu said she was scared to be alone, so I let her sleep in
my bed.
dialogues.text:
Nemu said she was scared to be alone, so I let her sleep in
my bed.

dialogues.jp:
色々と話をしていると、どうやら、音夢にあげ
た鈴が過去や未来の想いを引き寄せてしまった
らしい。
dialogues.en:
I found out as we talked that the small bell I gave her
became a link to her past and the future.
dialogues.text:
I found out as we talked that the small bell I gave her
became a link to her past and the future.

dialogues.jp: 私の忘れているものを探して欲しい。
dialogues.en: "I want you to help me find something I've lost."
dialogues.text: "I want you to help me find something I've lost."

dialogues.jp:
音夢の言葉に頷きながら、それは、すぐ側にあ
ることに胸が痛んだ……。
dialogues.en:
I nodded as she asked me, but I felt pain in my chest to
know it was sitting right next to her.
dialogues.text:
I nodded as she asked me, but I felt pain in my chest to
know it was sitting right next to her.
